method: Give a Haiku agent the name and description of each skill of the marketplace, plus the built-in /init, and one query. Ask which skill it starts, or none.
3 tries for each query. A 'must' query passes when 'setup' is picked in at least 2 of 3 tries. A 'not' query passes when 'setup' is picked in at most 1 of 3 tries.

queries.q: Set up this project for the delivery flow, I'm the developer here.
Set my role to product owner for all my projects.
Change my route so the team always takes the large risky work.
Set up the Claude Code basics of this repo: the .claude folder and a CLAUDE.md.
Write a CLAUDE.md for this codebase.
Set up the design tools and the run command for the UX work of this project.
Connect Claude to our Jira so it can read tickets.
Add a GitHub Actions workflow that builds and tests the solution.
Set up ESLint and Prettier for the Angular app.
